text:
Amanda: Hey team — putting the 'constraint ledger' up for visibility. Need to lock MVP scope by EOD Fri. TL;DR: propose moving Tenant Admin UI and Advanced Analytics to v1; keep SSO sign-in, Basic tenant settings, and core embeddings flow in MVP. Comments?

Devin: +1 on moving analytics and admin UI to v1. Quick Q: embeddings cache is infra-heavy — can we soft-launch without it and still meet SLOs?

Sanjay: From infra POV: embcache adds ~20% more GPU token cost/day but drops P95 by ~40–60ms for long-tail chats. Tradeoffs:
- Drop it: P95 +40–60ms, simpler rollout
- Keep it: needs ~2 eng wk per engineer (bigger schedule risk) + canary infra
- Sampled opt-in (50%): routing + metrics work but smaller blast radius.
Estimate for 50% opt-in: 1 eng + 1 SRE ~3 weeks.

Ellie: Design POV: search and recommendations suffer most without cache. We can scope the cache to prefix-only for MVP (tenant prompts only) which reduces complexity and UX edgecases. I'll mock two flows (with/without cache).

Tyler: Milestone note — if we push embcache to v1, we must add a contingency lane and a rollback-ready flag so product can toggle it without wedging release. Suggest a release flag: `mvp.contingency.embcache=false` and an explicit re-eval date.

Amanda: Proposed timeline: freeze MVP scope Fri EOD, feature-freeze next Tue 09:00, canary 2026-02-20, public launch 2026-03-05. If embcache moves to v1, we keep launch date but accept degraded latency on some flows. Any blockers?

Devin: Prefer keeping launch date. Move Analytics + Tenant Admin UI to v1. Embcache -> 50% opt-in soft-launch. +1 to release flag.

Sanjay: 50% opt-in requires traffic routing and new metrics. Adds infra work but less than full rollout. To free headcount we can deprioritize the low-priority autoshard task this sprint. Will confirm by EOD.

Ellie: I'll produce two sketches and a short acceptance checklist for each flow (with/without cache). Will upload by Wed. Acceptance examples:" with embedded code block: "```
- search P95 <= 350ms (with cache)
- search P95 <= 500ms (without cache)
- feature flag toggles without restart
```" continuing: "

Amanda: Action items: Amanda -> update constraint ledger doc (owners + dates); Devin -> draft rollout flag + flag QA steps; Sanjay -> headcount + deprioritization plan; Ellie -> designs + acceptance criteria. Owners: Amanda/Devin/Sanjay/Ellie. Ping here when done. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Reminder — schedule feature-freeze label with `/freeze mvp` before Tue 09:00 to lock PRs. :bell:

Tyler: I'll add the contingency lane into the milestone tracker and create the canary checklist. Scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 — invite sent. :calendar:
